canonical.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Quattro Passi

parent.title: Weekend in Nerano, dinner-anchored — with the anchor in legal limbo

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Quattro Passi
siblings.summary: Eleven character-driven places to sleep between Nerano village and Sorrento town, anchored by a Saturday dinner at the 2-star Quattro Passi — with taxi minutes and fares to each.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Quattro Passi
siblings.summary: A weekend menu of boat trips, hikes, hill-towns, ruins and food pilgrimages within day-trip range of Quattro Passi in Marina del Cantone.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Quattro Passi
siblings.summary: Sorrento hosts essentially one major IT-adjacent event in 2026 (ICSO, 12–16 Oct). Everything else is in Naples — ~30 km / 60–90 min drive — clustered at Federico II, Città della Scienza, and Stazione Marittima.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide — Quattro Passi, Nerano
sources.claim: Quattro Passi's Michelin status and address in Nerano village (Via Amerigo Vespucci 13N).

sources.title: Italia a Tavola — Quattro Passi salta la stagione 2026
sources.claim: Quattro Passi will not reopen for the 2026 season; Mellino family confirmed on 18 May 2026.

sources.title: Cronache della Campania — Quattro Passi seized
sources.claim: The entire Quattro Passi tourist accommodation complex was seized in January 2026 over building-permit irregularities.

sources.title: Hotels-in-Campania — Quattro Passi Relais
sources.claim: Quattro Passi Relais: Via Vespucci 13M, adults-only, 7 rooms, pool, 9.3/10 over 96 reviews, ~5 min walk to Nerano town centre.

sources.title: KAYAK — Quattro Passi Relais rates
sources.claim: Quattro Passi Relais nightly rates start from roughly $600 (KAYAK indicative).

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Villarena Relais
sources.claim: Villarena Relais ratings, $122-$374 nightly band, and the steep ~20+ min uphill walk back from the beach.

sources.title: Villarena Relais — official site
sources.claim: Villarena Relais address (Via Vespucci 13), pool, organic farm, cooking classes, and on-site dining experience.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — La Conca del Sogno
sources.claim: La Conca del Sogno is Via Vespucci 25, 11 min walk to Quattro Passi, 7 rooms, 3.7/5 (339 reviews).

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Marina del Cantone hotels
sources.claim: Marina del Cantone top-rated beachfront hotels with ratings and distance from cove centre.

sources.title: Hotel La Certosa — official site
sources.claim: Hotel La Certosa is a 3-star seafront hotel at Piazza Largo Argentina with private beach and on-site Da Pappone restaurant.

sources.title: Booking.com — Taverna del Capitano
sources.claim: Taverna del Capitano is a beachfront family-run property with a Michelin-star restaurant, scoring 9.3 on Booking.

sources.title: Booking.com — Marina del Cantone Chalet
sources.claim: Marina del Cantone Chalet is a 2-minute walk from Marina del Cantone Beach with kitchenette family rooms.

sources.title: Italy Heaven — Marina del Cantone
sources.claim: The footpath from Marina del Cantone beach up to Nerano village climbs 20-30 minutes from the car park.

sources.title: Booking.com — Quattro Passi Relais
sources.claim: Quattro Passi Relais is still showing 2026 availability on Booking.com despite the parent restaurant's seizure.
